offering_description.value: Leases commercial aircraft engines to airlines and other aircraft operators worldwide, and provides engine maintenance, repair and parts support. Engines are owned by the company and placed on lease, with repair and parts sold to customers.

primary_services.value: engine maintenance and repair; engine lease management

customer_segment.value: B2B: airlines, aircraft operators, aircraft lessors and maintenance shops

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: engine lease payments from airlines and operators; service fees: engine maintenance and repair work for customers; product sales: sales of used engine parts and components
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and leases aircraft engines to airlines and operators; service provider: repairs and maintains engines, sold to airlines and lessors

geography_served.value: global: customers across North America, Europe, Asia, Middle East and other regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: aircraft engine leasing, with related engine maintenance and parts

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: leases and sales made directly to airlines and lessors; own locations: company-operated engine repair and maintenance facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: aviation maintenance and airworthiness rules from FAA and EASA apply to engine repair and leasing

notes: Company size and the scope of owned aircraft versus engines are judgment calls based on general knowledge.
